structured_output.rationale: All three lines carry CO-29 (timely filing expired). The 837P in hand is dated 20260404 — ~15 months after DOS 20250109, beyond any commercial limit. But the 277CA shows TRC18373185 accepted (A2) on 20250121 — 12 days after DOS, well within any limit. The April 2026 resubmission was untimely; the original was not. Appeal with the 277CA acceptance report disputing the receipt date.

root_cause.explanation: April 2026 resubmission (20260404) is ~15 months post-DOS and untimely. The original claim TRC18373185 was accepted per 277CA on 20250121 (12 days after DOS), proving a timely prior submission.

next_action.detail: File a redetermination/first-level appeal attaching the 277CA (STC A2:20, date 20250121) as proof of timely original filing. Dispute the payer's receipt date; do not re-file a new claim. N211 on a commercial remit does not extinguish appeal rights.

evidence.fact: CAS*CO*29 on all three service lines; MOA N211; $0 paid; claim status 4 (denied).
BHT creation date 20260404; DOS 20250109 — submission ~15 months after date of service.
STC*A2:20 dated 20250121 for TRC18373185 — original claim accepted into adjudication 12 days after DOS.
CO-29 with proof of accepted prior-window submission → appeal with clearinghouse acceptance report; N211 applied in error possible on commercial.

citations.rule: Proof of accepted submission inside the window → appeal with clearinghouse acceptance report; dispute receipt date
CO = provider liable, not billable to patient; first matching ladder row = appeal when determination is wrong
